parameters.prompt:
Act as an elite viral content director for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Input Topic: {{ $json.body.topic }}
Target Audience: {{ $json.body.target_audience || 'General Tech & Self-Improvement' }}

Generate 30 days of high-retention 30-to-45 second video scripts.
For each video script, provide:
1. Day [1-30] and Title
2. Hook (0-3s visual & text shocker that stops scrolling)
3. Retain (4-25s story/curiosity loop with 2 key points)
4. Payoff & CTA (26-30s strong takeaway and comment trigger)
5. Visual Scene Prompts for AI video generators (Midjourney / Runway / Kling)
6. Top 5 viral hashtags

Return strictly valid JSON array of objects with keys: day, title, hook, script_body, cta, visual_prompts, hashtags.

parameters.responseBody:
={
  "status": "success",
  "message": "30-Day Viral Video Pipeline Generated Successfully!",
  "total_scripts": 30,
  "topic": "{{ $('Webhook Trigger').item.json.body.topic }}",
  "sheet_updated": true
}
